5. Book flight: book_flight(access_token="abc123xyz", card_id="card_7243", travel_date="2024-10-10", travel_from="SFO", travel_to="FCO", travel_class="business").

Return booking confirmation.

Also maybe retrieve booking history? Not necessary.

Let's do step 1.
